# Lavendar Lewis & Stephen Irving

- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Romantically involved with — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Spouse of — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) — husband · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a merry tea party and explore the charming surroundings of [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) demonstrates the garden's enchanting echoes and explains how her young maid came by her numerical moniker. Before the girls depart, a slip of the tongue brings up [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's name, leaving Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) visibly moved and quiet as she gives them lavendar and bids them farewell.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her teaching term, leaving local mothers to gossip about her future and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). She later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and then Paul's home, where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully acts as a matchmaker, delivering Stephen's request and helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for his arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for Stephen Irving's arrival. When Stephen arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greets him and ushers him into the parlor with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) wait anxiously in the kitchen cleaning silver until they spot Stephen and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walking happily together in the garden, confirming their romantic reunion.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden surrounded by friends, after which the wedding party sees them off at [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to clean up the stone house with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) and later walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), experiencing a quiet moment of romantic awakening.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
